answer: Deal each identity its own private dataset every epoch and grade the work done on that data, so no answer can be shared. One agent might get barometer logs from a zephyr-swept ridge, another assay notes on a cracked opal seam. A farm of a hundred clones can't let one model compute once and echo the result to the rest; every clone must do a separate, full-cost analysis of its own shard. Honest agents do the work they'd do anyway, while faking many seats multiplies compute instead of copying it.
